offering_description.value: EZCORP makes short-term loans to consumers who pledge personal property as collateral. Its pawnshops also buy and sell secondhand goods, including items from unredeemed loans.

primary_products.value: Secondhand jewelry; consumer electronics; tools; musical instruments; sporting goods

primary_services.value: Short-term loans secured by personal property

customer_segment.value: B2C: Pawn borrowers and shoppers buying secondhand goods; B2B: Precious-metal refiners buying scrap jewelry

end_markets.value: Consumer credit; secondhand retail; precious-metal recycling

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: Interest and finance charges on pawn loans; product sales: Secondhand merchandise sold to shoppers and scrap jewelry sold to refiners

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: Accepts personal property as collateral and lends cash to consumers; retailer: Sells purchased and unredeemed goods to secondhand shoppers

geography_served.value: global: United States, Mexico and Central America

specialization.value: related lines: Pawn lending and secondhand merchandise sales through the same stores

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated pawnshops serving borrowers and shoppers; direct sales: Bulk scrap jewelry sales to precious-metal refiners

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Pawnshop licensing or registration, loan charge limits and disclosure rules enforced by U.S. and Latin American authorities
